answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, expired if not renewed by fresh work, rewards vest against future work. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the orchard of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The forge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the echo.
